name: Grand Reserve at The Meritage
positioning: Grand Reserve is part of The Meritage Resort and Spa, a 36-acre Napa wine country resort with a spa set in a wine cave and vineyard view rooms
best_for: Couples who want a spa day in a wine cave with a vineyard view adult pool
Families wanting suites with kitchens, a family pool and vineyard trails

facts.text: Accommodations range from vineyard view rooms to two-bedroom suites with kitchens.
One bedroom suites have a living room, kitchen and large patio.
Guests can upgrade to a Pure Room with allergen-free amenities.
Wellness classes are held in the vineyard, the Estate Cave or the Motion Studio.
Spa guests can begin with a guided yoga class and steam room session, then unwind at the adult pool with lunch and a soak in the hot tub.
There is a family pool with cabanas.
The resort offers a complimentary shuttle to downtown Napa.
The resort has over a dozen on-site restaurants, bars, cafes and tasting rooms, plus a bowling alley.
Wine Tasting at The Village offers on-site tasting rooms by Napa wineries.
The Meritage Resort and Spa is celebrating its 20th anniversary throughout 2026.

highlights.text: Spa Terra is set within a wine cave beneath the vines.
Spa Terra offers a vineyard view adult pool.
Guests can explore vineyard walking trails, a chicken coop and the Chef's Garden.
During the Merry Meritage holiday season the resort offers ice skating, princess teas and family festivities.

considerations.text: Spa Terra welcomes guests 18 years or older.
No lifeguards are on duty at the family pool, so parents are advised to watch children.
The Meritage Resort and Spa is a cashless property.
